market_question: Will Silver (SI) hit (HIGH) $120 by end of June?
reasoning: Silver currently trades around $31/oz. Reaching $120 by June 2026 would require a ~4x rally in ~15 months, a move far exceeding any historical rally and pushing silver to a nominal price more than double its all-time high of ~$50. Even under extreme inflationary scenarios, such a level is extremely improbable within this timeframe.
evidence_points: Silver spot price approximately $31/oz as of early 2025.
All-time nominal high for silver is ~$50/oz (1980); inflation-adjusted highs are far lower.
No CME silver futures settlement history above $50.
Required quadrupling in 15 months is unprecedented in modern silver markets.
